body.name: mixed marked--unmarked polynomial hybrid handle
body.construction: Construct \(\widehat\tau^{\mathrm{mix}}_{n,m,d}\) by an independent pooled-count pilot that separates light and heavy \((X,A)\) cells, a near-best reciprocal polynomial on the light branch whose factorial lift is linear in \(q_{ax}\) and uses higher powers only of \(s_{ax}\), an inverse-count outcome mean on the heavy branch, mass-weighted aggregation across \(x\), and final clipping to \([-1,1]\); derive all tuning constants from \(n,m,d,\epsilon\) alone.
